title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Is deleting Quranic verses from mobile, like images, audios etc correct or sinful? 5880 views Q. I started working in a chartered accountant firm and enroled myself for CA. Please tell me the recording of facts in current senario of INDIAN economic system is lawful? beacuse an accontant has to record all the financial matters. 1955 views Q. I am a strict follower of deoband thinking . I am having a daughter which is just 1 and half years old and is suffering from Thallasemia disease( in which every month blood has to be given to child) . The cause of this as explained to us by the doctors is due to parents. till today there is no proper cure for this disease and it looks like artificial life of the child. meaning go on giving blood every month to keep her alive. Now my wife is pregnant and we are expecting a second child , the doctors say that there is a test which can be done at the early stage of pregnancy in which we can come the know whether the child in the womb of the mother will be having a disease or not. supposes(nauzubillah) if the child is also having the same problem, then can we get the child aborted or not .Because if the second child is also having the same problem of blood then you can imagine how difficult the life will be for the parents to get blood every month for their child and it looks like a total artificial life of children. please advice me soon as i have to take a decision urgently . Allah given you'll plenty of jazai khair 2702 views Q. I wish to start a business of Exporting Ladies Suits from India to various countries across the world. My 1st customer, who is also a Muslim, says that while despatching the goods from India to his country (In Africa), I should not declare the actual value of goods which I shall be sending but something less than that. eg: Goods worth Rs. 10,000/- may be declared as Goods worth Rs. 1,000/- in order to avoid Tax/Duty which would be paid by him & by me to the respective Governments. Is this permissible according to The Deen of Allah SWT? 1943 views Q. I have my contract to the various Autoriksha owners. If these poster are designed by me (on my liking only) and then I past them on the autoriksha? 3. Regarding taking of fees by advocate 1980 views Q. I recently attended a wedding at at the end a few brothers were called to the stage to take photographs. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 24489 Country: India Title: Is sperm donation allowed in Islam? Question: Is sperm donation allowed in Islam ? Answer ID: 24489 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1239/960/D=1431) No, it is not allowed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
